title: Portal pact acceptance payload
description: Sent by the invited player's world to the inviting world as {"message": "<payload>.<signature>"} to POST /federation/pacts. Signature is Ed25519 over 'ishtaria/portal-pact-accept/v1' + 0x00 + the decoded payload, made with the sender world's key.

from_world.description: DNS name of a world (its permanent identity).

from_player.description: Account name (localpart) on the issuing world.

to_world.description: DNS name of a world (its permanent identity).

from_api_url.description: Public API URL of the sending world, used to fetch its server key on first contact.
